\chapter{Binary Representation}
\label{ch:introduction}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{Every integer is a string of bits: learn to read it, convert it, fix its width and survive signed overflow.}}
\end{tcolorbox}

\chapterfacts{Beginner}{1200}{5}{10}{30}

\begin{plannedbox}[Planned Contents --- this chapter is not written yet]
\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item Positional systems: binary, octal, hexadecimal and base $-2$; converting by repeated division and by grouping bits
    \item Fixed-width integers: \texttt{int}, \texttt{long long}, \texttt{unsigned}, \texttt{\_\_int128}; the range of each
    \item Two's complement: why $-x = \sim x + 1$, the asymmetric range, and signed overflow as undefined behaviour
    \item Bit numbering and printing: bit $i$ has value $2^i$, \texttt{std::bitset} for printing, endianness as a footnote
    \item Binary strings as numbers: reading a bit string modulo $m$, and when the number does not fit in 64 bits
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Part B --- Patterns} (with the two solved problems of each pattern)
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{P\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item \textbf{Bases and conversions} --- Convert a Number to Hexadecimal {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 405)}, Convert to Base -2 {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1017)}
    \item \textbf{Reading the bits of a number} --- Binary Gap {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 868)}, Binary Number with Alternating Bits {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 693)}
    \item \textbf{Fixed width: complement and reversal} --- Number Complement {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 476)}, Reverse Bits {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 190)}
    \item \textbf{Signed integers and overflow} --- Divide Two Integers {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 29)}, Integer Replacement {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 397)}
    \item \textbf{Binary strings as numbers} --- Binary Prefix Divisible By 5 {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1018)}, Concatenation of Consecutive Binary Numbers {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1680)}
\end{enumerate}
\end{plannedbox}
